'''Subcommand Three''' was a secure deck on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''. In order to reach it, someone would have to use a fingerprint scanner in a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] entered a turbolift to go here during the [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]], but got in a small skirmish with [[Alema Rar]] upon entering the turbolift.
